_comment: Pinned toolchain for this repo's evidence, checked (not merely recorded)
before any PVT point is simulated. Keep in sync with the version table in
docs/environment-setup.md §1 -- changing a pin here means re-validating
that document and re-running sim/selftest.sh.
open_pdks         exact open_pdks commit hash the gf180mcu models must
come from ('volare output --pdk gf180mcu'). Exact,
because the hash IS the device models: a different one
silently yields numbers no other record is comparable
with. Set to null to disable the check (not recommended).
ngspice_min_major floor, not an exact match -- newer ngspice is allowed
and recorded; older is refused.
python_min        floor, as 'major.minor'.
xschem_tag        upstream release tag the netlisting toolchain is
built from (docs/environment-setup.md SS1/SS2).
xschem_commit     exact commit that tag resolves to, for a from-source
CI build's cache key. Recorded but not yet checked by
toolchain.check()/run_corners.py --check-env -- xschem
has no --version-parseable-enough banner comparison
wired up yet; sim/smoke_test/run_smoke_test.sh already
fails outright if xschem is missing.
A drift is fatal by default; --allow-toolchain-drift overrides it and
stamps the drift into every record written under it.
